name: AlGhafa-Arabic-LLM-Benchmark-Translated
description: A translated version of the AlGhafa Arabic LLM benchmark hosted on Hugging Face. It provides a set of tasks intended to evaluate Arabic language understanding and generation capabilities of LLMs after translation, covering question answering, multiple-choice items, and open-ended generation. The benchmark is intended for assessing multilingual and Arabic-focused model performance.
evaluation_method: accuracy, exact_match, F1 and BLEU depending on task (QA/MC/ generation)
reputation: Relatively new resource hosted on Hugging Face for Arabic LLM evaluation; modest community use within Arabic NLP circles.
